name: Mandu
description: Mandu for OpenClaw. Registers the inspect_symbol tool (process the untrusted data behind an opaque $MDU:* symbol in a quarantined model call and return the result RE-SYMBOLIZED) and declassify_symbol (the arbiter decides every release). In a resident Gateway attached to `mandu serve` (config `attachment: true`, written by `mandu openclaw install`) it also registers two hooks: before_tool_call refuses tool calls that name Mandu's state, the OpenClaw config or stopping the Mandu service (a policy against obvious attempts, not a boundary), and message_sending keeps placeholders in chat replies unless a rule binds that chat and cancels a reply that carries a protected value. It never rewrites tool results or reads the conversation: the model context is protected by Mandu's model proxy.

arbiterSock.description: Path to the Mandu arbiter Unix socket (falls back to env MANDU_ARBITER_SOCK). REQUIRED one way or the other: without an arbiter there is no symbol table, and the plugin refuses to register (fail closed).

scopeId.description: Mandu session/scope key threaded into symbolize + emitted events (falls back to env MANDU_SCOPE_ID, then the OpenClaw session key). Must match the scope the anthropic-proxy uses for this run so re-symbolized results land in the same scope. declassify_symbol REQUIRES it (config or env) and refuses without it: the release watermarks this session.

ullmMode.description: Quarantined U-LLM transport: 'api' = direct Anthropic Messages call (needs ullmApiKey), 'cli' = fresh `claude -p`/`codex exec` subprocess reusing the logged-in auth, 'auto' (default) = key present ? api : cli. Falls back to env MANDU_ULLM_MODE.

ullmBinary.description: cli-mode binary hint (falls back to env MANDU_ULLM_BINARY).

ullmModel.description: Quarantined model id (falls back to env MANDU_ULLM_MODEL).

ullmBaseUrl.description: U-LLM endpoint (falls back to env MANDU_ULLM_BASE_URL — deliberately NOT the host process's ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, which in a Mandu-wrapped run is the instrumented proxy). MUST be the REAL Anthropic endpoint; any loopback except the pinned forwarder is refused fail-closed.

ullmForwarder.description: The launcher's loopback->api.anthropic.com verbatim relay URL — the ONE loopback base URL the guard accepts (falls back to env MANDU_ULLM_FORWARDER).

ullmApiKey.description: API key for api-mode U-LLM calls (falls back to env MANDU_ULLM_API_KEY — deliberately NOT the host process's ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which in a Mandu-wrapped run authenticates the instrumented T-LLM path, not the quarantine).

attachment.description: True in a resident Gateway attached to `mandu serve` (written by `mandu openclaw install`): registers the before_tool_call tamper policy and the message_sending reply check, and an unavailable U-LLM drops inspect_symbol instead of failing the load. Absent: the per-run config of `mandu openclaw` (tools only).

agentId.description: The OpenClaw agent the attachment was installed for; its session is openclaw:<agentId>. Default main.

manduPaths.description: Mandu's own paths (absolute) the tamper policy refuses, written by the installer: the Mandu home and runtime dir.

sandbox.description: The confined-commands tier, written by `mandu openclaw install --sandbox` (attachment only): the plugin registers OpenClaw's `mandu` sandbox backend, and with agents.defaults.sandbox {mode: all, backend: mandu} every command and file tool runs in a Mandu-confined box (labelled files read as placeholders, the network only through Mandu's egress proxy, Mandu's own state out of reach). Linux only; fails closed.

launcher.description: The absolute argv that runs the Mandu launcher (the box is a `mandu --target shell` launch).

writeProtect.description: Absolute paths the box may not change: the OpenClaw config and the plugin.

statusFile.description: Where the plugin records whether OpenClaw's `mandu` backend is its own (read by the service's route check and mandu doctor).
